title: DHS conducted far-reaching surveillance during Minnesota ICE surge, court documents show
summary: DHS allegedly went undercover at community meetings, subpoenaed the financial records of labor unions, and created dossiers on people at a church gathering, according to court filings.
contentText:
DHS allegedly went undercover at community meetings, subpoenaed the financial records of labor unions, and created dossiers on people at a church gathering, according to court filings.

(Image credit: Jaida Grey Eagle for NPR)
